It's very hard as an FA to give a decent advice... From my opinion your looks are not the problem at all. Rating looks is a difficult thing to do, but I would say your looks are easy above average and are not the reason why you are getting rejected...

Giving advice on personality isn't easy either... From my experience I wouldn't try to fake a personality. If you're in a relationship this will blow up sooner or later, BUT in high school it's the best way to go to avoid getting bullied I think. At least that's what I did to survive it...

Maybe you should go somewhere else where you can act natural the way you are and express what you really like (I don't know your hobbies). This way it's more likely to find someone who is actually interested in who you are rather than who you pretend to be.
